publication.citation: Zhao, D. (2022). Electron Probe Microanalysis and Microscopy of Polishing-Exposed Solid-Phase Mineral Inclusions in Fuxian Kimberlite Diamonds. Minerals 12 (7), 844.
publication.notes: Tables 2-5 (pp. 14-19): electron-microprobe major elements of olivine, chromite, garnet and orthopyroxene inclusions analysed in this study, exposed by polishing. Sample labels (LN50D...) name the host diamond throughout the paper, so the same label in two tables is the same diamond. Not extracted: the columns of Tables 4 and 5 that the footnotes attribute to earlier papers (Harris et al., Wang and Guo, Meyer et al.); the authors' recalculated Fe2O3 and FeO and second total in Tables 3 and 4 (calculated by charge balance, not measured); calculated cations and Mg#, Ca#, Cr#; Table 6 (sulfides, element wt%); Tables 7 and 8 (unknown hydrous and Fe-rich phases; water by difference, several analyses of one inclusion); Table 1 (list of minerals identified).

tool: extraction/extract.py (pdftotext -layout; hints in this file under "extract"; tables checked against page images of pp. 14-19) + scripts/build_gold.py

method.conditions: Cameca CAMEBAX electron microprobe (University of Michigan), WDS with PAP correction; focused beam in spot mode; peak and background counting 30 s and 15 s (Si in chromite 120 s). Silicates (olivine, pyroxene, garnet): 15 kV, 10 nA. Spinel/chromite: 10 kV, 45 nA.
